scope: No model calls, no business execution, no auth/config reads, no original fixture/profile/freeze/run changes; only ignored packaging code and new verification artifacts.

fixes.problem: Stored absolute fixture descriptors could point to a retired checkout.
fixes.change: Resolve current paths from domain/caseId under the explicit experiment root; accept canonical legacy absolute tails or portable relative descriptors without rewriting frozen JSON. Reject inconsistent paths, duplicate IDs, symlink roots, and oracle/task inside model workspace.

fixes.problem: REVIEW_INCOMPLETE without row.error previously exited zero.
fixes.change: A live incomplete result now exits nonzero; a successfully submitted UNVERIFIED still counts as a completed review.

fixes.problem: Descriptor reader accepted arrays only while runner also allowed an object.cases envelope.
fixes.change: Normalize both input shapes and resolve only cases present in the chosen audit run.

interface.rootOverride: REVIEW_EXPERIMENT_ROOT (relative to current repository or absolute; output still restricted to the experiment lab)

packaging.skipReason: Sandbox filesystem did not permit creation of a symlink/junction fixture; validation code remains in place.

packagingMinimum: prompt-accuracy scripts, fixture-paths/run-outcome helpers and packaging-checks
Curated fixtures with workspace as the sole worker-visible root; task/oracle/provenance remain siblings
Unchanged profiles, freeze descriptors and independent semantic audits
Small retained run/decision/prompt/events summaries, excluding sessions/auth/node_modules/full frozen copies
limitations: select-profile.mjs is the preserved one-off historical development selection, not a generic prompt optimizer; it was not changed.
No exact final HTTP payload/network audit was performed.
The relocation check reused two copied frozen cases offline; live review outcomes were not rerun or relabelled.
Current domain/case schema is deliberately limited to curated kitchen/flower descriptors.
